Enumerate s7: 1,039 spellings swept, floor holds at 7 with 169 ties and zero improvements — the LZC arm's local naming/order/commutativity space is exhausted and the s6 frontier's scale-liveness lever

frontier.hypothesis: The residual does not live in the LZC arm's local spelling space (471 spellings, flat at 7) nor in scale's liveness (killed, 15-47 insns) nor in the copy's carrier identity (killed, cse folds either way). What is left, in priority order, is (a) the pre-branch block's naming space in the INTERLEAVED store shape, which s7's e4 sweep did NOT cover, and (b) the island's own operand plumbing.
frontier.mechanism: spelling_enum treats a memory store as an anchor and moves it to the end of the region, so every e4 variant emitted the three SCRV stores after the whole diff+square+sum computation — a shape that is ~35 insns worse to begin with. The interleaved shape (candidate.c's) has never had its naming/order space enumerated, and it is the block where the target's island-input copy must be born (s6).
frontier.next_probe: Build the interleaved pre-branch region by hand rather than with spelling_enum: keep `SCRV->x = dx;` immediately after each diff and enumerate only the diff/square/sum naming around them (name each `((s32 *)arg0[1])[5]` load, each `arg1[10]` load, each square; keep/inline each; order the declarations). ~200-600 hand-generated variants, swept with the s7 run_sweep.sh wrapper at ~1.05 s each. Alternatively teach spelling_enum a --stores-are-statements flag so `SCRV->x = dx;` is reorderable rather than anchored, which would make the region enumerable directly.

frontier.hypothesis: With the LZC arm exhausted, the remaining 7 insns are most likely a property of the LZC island's own operand plumbing rather than of any C statement around it — which is exactly the still-UNCLASSIFIED tied-output operand question the s5/s6 frontier left open.
frontier.mechanism: s5's w6 lineage (rejected/tied-copy-dowhile-wrap-copy-seats-v1-not-a0-equal-floor-7.c) reaches the same floor 7 but with the residual reduced to ONE register name, because a tied `"=r"/"1"` operand pair materialises the island-input copy in the target's delay-slot position. That operand declares an output the island's text never writes and is not covered by any family in .claude/rules/, so the lineage cannot be driven to a candidate-ready without a ruling.
frontier.next_probe: Grep docs/reference/sotn-construct-index.md for tied / multi-output inline-asm operand precedent among PSX (untagged) entries. If there is none, emit a ruling-request asking whether an authorized canonical-asm island may carry a tied "=r"/"1" operand pair whose only effect is to materialise a copy the target itself contains. Do this BEFORE spending a session driving the w6 lineage to zero — it is the cheapest remaining unblocking move.

frontier.hypothesis: The unstaged spelling space (the whole LZC arm written with a FRESH named local carrying the LZCR read instead of reusing log2_val) is a 3,440-spelling family whose two sampled endpoints both score 13; sweeping it would either find the 6-insn win the staged space does not contain, or convert s7's instance kill of the arm into a much stronger statement.
frontier.mechanism: The staged and unstaged families differ in whether pseudo 98 (log2_val) conflicts with pseudo 77 (sum_sq) — s6's conflict-set requirement (ii). The staged family is flat at 7; the unstaged family has never been swept beyond its two endpoints, and it is the only family in which (ii) is satisfied.
frontier.next_probe: Sweep tmp/grind/func_80018094/s7/enum/ (already generated: 3,440 variants, ~63 min single-threaded at 1.05 s each) with the s7 run_sweep.sh wrapper. Launch it as the FIRST action of the session so it finishes in-turn, and bank the histogram; a zero-hit sweep converts H31 into a two-family exhaustion statement covering both sides of the (ii) conflict.
